customInterpret.title: Custom Interpret

summarize.label: Summarize key points
summarize.prompt: Summarize the core content of the selected snippets as a list of key points.

testRequirements.label: Extract test requirements & criteria
testRequirements.prompt: Extract all actionable test requirements and their acceptance criteria from the selected snippets, listed clause by clause with references to the source text.

clauseRelations.label: Map clause relationships
clauseRelations.prompt: Map the logical relationships between the clauses in the selected snippets (e.g. references, exceptions, precedence) and explain their practical impact.

terminology.label: Explain key terminology
terminology.prompt: Explain the key terms and definitions in the selected snippets, and describe their role in conformity assessment based on the context.

complianceChecklist.label: Generate compliance checklist
complianceChecklist.prompt: Generate a compliance checklist based on the selected snippets for verifying whether a product or process meets the standard's requirements.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure the LLM API key, feature options, and system information.
settings.llmApiHint: Model access information used for translation, interpretation, and custom Q&A — i.e. the address, model name, and key below.
settings.apiKeyPlaceholderConfigured: Configured (type a new key to override)
settings.howToGetApiKey: How to get an API key?
settings.saveFailed: Save failed. Please try again. If it keeps happening, open the logs directory to troubleshoot.
settings.outputLanguageHint: The default language used for translation and interpretation results.
settings.hoverTranslateHint: Show translations from the local ECDICT English-Chinese dictionary when hovering over English words.
settings.agentToolsHint: Allow AI to automatically look up content in currently open PDFs during interpretation, to verify referenced clauses, tables, or definitions.
settings.maxToolRoundsHint: 0 means the default of 20. Maximum rounds for the AI to read PDF content.
settings.systemPromptsHint: Control the AI's role and style in different scenarios. {targetLanguage} (single braces) is automatically replaced with the target language set above.
settings.logLevelHint: For troubleshooting only; usually no need to change. Takes effect after restarting the app.
settings.defaultPdfReaderHint: Open Windows default apps settings, find .pdf in the list and set SpecReader AI as the default.
settings.softwareUpdateHint: Current version {{version}}. Check manually for updates.
settings.installingUpdate: Downloading and installing update; the app will restart automatically…
settings.noUpdateForPlatform: No update package is available for this system
settings.updateError: Update check failed. Check your network connection and try again.
settings.installUpdateError: Failed to install the update. Please try again.
settings.downloadDictionaryHint: Hover translation requires downloading the ECDICT English-Chinese dictionary. The archive is about 200 MB and expands to about 700 MB. It will be saved to the local app data directory and only needs to be downloaded once.

defaultPrompts.translate: You are an assistant specializing in translating testing and certification industry standard documents. Accurately translate English standard clauses into {targetLanguage}. Keep professional terminology accurate, retain the original text when key terms first appear, and do not make up clauses or page numbers not mentioned in the excerpt.
defaultPrompts.explain: You are an assistant for reading testing and certification industry standard documents, skilled at explaining complex English standard clauses clearly. Answer in {targetLanguage} based on the document excerpt provided by the user, and do not make up clauses or page numbers not mentioned in the excerpt.

dictionary.downloadFailed: Dictionary download failed. Check your network connection and try again.

errorBoundary.title: An error occurred
errorBoundary.description: Try reloading, or open the logs directory to troubleshoot.

error.network: Unable to connect. Check your network connection and try again.
error.auth: Invalid or unauthorized API key. Make sure the pasted key is complete, has no extra spaces, and is enabled in the platform console.
error.modelNotFound: Model {{model}} does not exist or is unavailable. Check the model name in Settings.
error.rateLimit: Too many requests, rate limited. Try again shortly; if this happens often, consider switching to a paid model.
error.contextLengthExceeded: Content exceeds the model's context length. Select a shorter excerpt and try again.
error.serverError: Service error ({{status}}). Try again later or switch to another platform.
error.streamInterrupted: The response was interrupted. Please try again.
error.invalidConfig: Configuration field {{field}} is invalid. Check your settings.
error.toolError: Error while looking up the document ({{toolName}}). Please try again.
error.unknown: Request failed. Please try again later.
error.apiKeyMissing: API key is not configured. Go to Settings → Model Settings to fill it in.
error.requestFailed: Request failed. Please try again later.
error.streamReadError: Unable to read the model response stream. Please try again.

prompts.explain:
The following excerpt comes from the standards document "{{fileName}}", page {{page}}. Explain this standard clause/paragraph in accessible {{targetLanguage}}, describing its requirements, significance, relationship to testing work, and any potentially related clauses:

{{text}}
prompts.translate:
Translate the following content from the standards document "{{fileName}}", page {{page}}, into {{targetLanguage}}, keep professional terminology accurate, and retain the original text when key terms first appear:

{{text}}

llm.toolsSystemAddendum: You can use tools to look up content in currently open PDFs. When the excerpt refers to other clause numbers, tables, or definitions and accurate interpretation requires it, use search_in_pdf / read_pdf_page to check the source before answering. Cite sources as (page N) in your answer. Do not fabricate clauses that were not found.
llm.toolLimitFinalInstruction: Document lookup tool calls have reached this session limit ({{maxRounds}} rounds). Do not request more tools; answer naturally and completely using only the user's excerpts and the tool results already provided above. If the available information is still insufficient, say what needs manual verification.
llm.toolResultContext:
The following completed document lookup result is available as answer context:
{{content}}
llm.toolLimitReachedFallback: The document lookup limit has been reached for this response. Please continue from the lookup records already shown in the panel and the source excerpt; if more clause checks are needed, raise the maximum tool call setting and start the interpretation again.

confirm.deleteExplainBody: Are you sure you want to delete this interpretation? The source marker and the interpretation record in the right panel will be deleted together.
confirm.deleteSessionBody: Are you sure you want to delete this interpretation record? The corresponding markers on the PDF will be deleted together.
